commit.message:
LU-17000 utils: Use safer getrandom vs random

Coverity complains about using random() and instead
suggests a compliant random number generator, such as
/dev/random or /dev/urandom (getrandom)

Test-Parameters: trivial
CoverityID: 506113 ("Calling risky function")
